profile_text.body:
Beautiful.ai is a software company that offers an AI-powered presentation platform aimed at enterprise teams and businesses of varying sizes. The company describes its product as a tool that keeps slide decks on-brand and ready to share across an organization, with offerings oriented toward individual users, small teams and startups, enterprise implementations, and one-time slideshow creation. A 14-day free trial with unlimited access to features is available, and the company maintains a separate pricing page for plan details.

The core product, also called Beautiful.ai, centers on a feature set that includes over 300 auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts, shared brand themes covering colors, fonts, and logos, and a library of data visualization slides such as charts, graphs, timelines, and diagrams. The company's newer workflow, called Create with AI, is described as a context-aware, guided process that lets users shape a text-first outline before committing to design, then iterate on individual slides without regenerating an entire deck. The site claims customers Paciolan and Cvent each cut presentation design time by 75% after adopting the platform, and that IDC analysts reduced production time while surfacing new data insights.

The held facts confirm Beautiful.ai maintains a tracked product in the Slides and Presentations category, listed under its own name with presentation generation as the noted function. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the available data.
